title.narrative: safe pathways for at risk youth in jordan

description.narrative: Collectively the project will improve the capacities of Jordanian civil society and youth living in Jordan for effective implementation and adoption of human security-based solutions and resilience building throughyouth and women-focused protection, empowerment, and prevention mechanisms in Jordan. From a protection lens, the project seeks to address the high prevalence of digital vulnerability to empower women and youth with knowledge and capacities to improve digital literacy and responsible behaviours. It also aims to establish alternative safe pathways for at-risk youth and women populations. This will be achieved by combining the protection component with empowerment focused programming that effectively integrates at risk youth and women into CCI offering avenues for sustainable livelihoods generation to build self-reliance and resilience.
